landing.badge: Now with retrieval from official 2025 tax sources
landing.heroText: Ask any question about German taxes and get a clear, cited answer, in your language. Built for employees and expats doing their own Steuererklärung.
landing.scopeNote: A demonstration, not a filing service. Nothing is sent to the tax office.
landing.trustTitle: Answers grounded in official German sources
landing.feature1Body: No legal jargon. Every reply is structured with a summary, explanation and the official sources it drew from.
landing.feature2Body: Ask in English, Deutsch, Türkçe or по-русски, answers come back in the same language, terminology intact.
landing.feature3Body: Covers the employee tax return for 2025, commuting, home office, work equipment, business trips, job-related moves and more.
landing.ctaText: Free during the 2025 tax season. No account needed to start asking.
landing.footerNote: © 2025 German Tax Assistant · Informational only, not tax advice.

scope.deadlineNote: The first date is the deadline for a return you are obliged to file without a tax adviser (§ 149 Abs. 2 AO); the second is the general deadline when an adviser prepares it (§ 149 Abs. 3 AO), and the tax office may still demand the return earlier (Vorabanforderung). A deadline falling on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday moves to the next working day (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). With no obligation to file, a voluntary return has four years.
scope.limitsIntro: This is a demonstration on a free plan. These limits are enforced, not advisory.

scope.notSupportedIntro: These are left out on purpose, not missing by accident.

notSupported.electronic_submission: Submit anything to the tax office. Every PDF is a draft you file yourself.
notSupported.tax_advice: Give tax advice. It explains rules and does the arithmetic; it does not advise.
notSupported.self_employment: Self-employment or business income (Anlage S, Anlage G, EÜR).
notSupported.corporate_or_non_resident: Company filings, or filings for people not resident in Germany.
notSupported.progressionsvorbehalt_rate: Work out the rate effect of wage replacement benefits. It records the amount only.
notSupported.document_archive: Store your documents. A document is read for its figures - twice, and the two readings are compared - and is not kept afterwards.
